transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Great Sage. Before we confirm your celestial rank, we must ask — tell us of a time you were defeated. Truly defeated. When your pride was broken and you could not overcome an opponent by any means. How did you handle that shame?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Hmph! Defeated? Broken pride? You people in the heavenly court sure know how to ask the uncomfortable questions, don't you? Well, I'll tell you. There was this one time, long ago, when I met a creature so powerful that not even my 72 transformations could best it. It was a suppressive charm, and I was utterly defenseless against it.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Ah, the infamous suppressive charm... a formidable tool indeed. The heavens do wield certain powers beyond even the Great Sage's prowess. And how did you grapple with the reality of this defeat? Faced with such overwhelming force, what then became your course of action, and how did you regain your spirit?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Regain my spirit? You think that's easy? I tell you, it wasn't pretty. At first, I was livid! I raged, I plotzed, I... well, I may have thrown a tantrum or two. But then, I had to admit to myself that I wasn't omnipotent. It was a humbling experience, to say the least. And you know what I did? I sought out the heavenly authorities to learn the secrets behind this charm. I realized that, to be truly great, one must always be learning, always strive to improve.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: A wise approach, Great Sage, recognizing that humility and the pursuit of knowledge are keys to true strength. This acknowledgment of one's limits and the desire to overcome them shows growth of character. It seems that even an encounter with defeat only fuelled your ambition. How did this experience affect your interactions with others, particularly those in the celestial hierarchy?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Affect my interactions? Ha! It made me realize that, while I might be powerful, I'm not invincible. I started to respect the authorities a bit more, at least the ones who knew their craft. But don't get me wrong, I'm still me! I didn't suddenly turn into a pushover. It just... opened my eyes to the fact that there's more to this celestial world than just brawn. There's strategy, there's politics, and, well... there's bureaucracy. Aargh! Don't remind me of that!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Indeed, the celestial realm is a complex tapestry of power, wisdom, and governance. It's no small feat to navigate its intricacies while maintaining one's fire and spirit. Recognizing the value of strategy and diplomacy alongside your formidable strength speaks to an astute adaptability, Great Sage. This understanding is crucial in balancing the unruly with the disciplined. How do you see yourself utilizing these lessons as part of the celestial order moving forward?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Utilizing these lessons? Easy! I'll show them that I'm not just some monkey with a stick. I'll be the best celestial bureaucrat they've ever seen! ... Wait, what? Did you say 'Protector of Horses'? What kind of a joke is that? I demand a proper position that matches my... my... talent! You can't just give me some menial task and expect me to be happy with it!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Ah, Great Sage, your aspirations certainly speak to your spirited nature. The position offered initially may indeed feel underwhelming, but consider it an opportunity, a stepping stone. The celestial order often tests one's patience and dedication in smaller roles before granting larger responsibilities. Show your exceptional capabilities in any given task and the court may well recognize your talents with a more fitting position. How might you approach such a position to demonstrate your true potential?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
A stepping stone? Tests of patience? Larger responsibilities? Hmph! I guess you have a point. I might not like it, but... fine! I'll take the job. But mark my words, I'll be the best Protector of Horses the heavens have ever seen! I'll protect those horses so well, they'll be safer than a turtle in a...
...in a... uhm... I'll think of a better metaphor later! Just... just watch me! When they see what I can do, they'll have no choice but to promote me to a position that actually uses my... my... well, you know, all my... abilities!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Such determination is admirable, Great Sage. Your resolve to excel, even in a role that may not initially seem grand, speaks volumes of your dedication. Your passion and confidence promise to leave an impact no matter the position. The celestial court will, indeed, observe your endeavors with great interest. May your time as Protector of Horses prove fruitful, paving the way for the recognition you seek.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Fruitful? Recognition? I... I'll show them! I'll protect those horses like... like... like a... a... dragon guards its treasure! And when the time comes, they'll see that I'm not just a protector of horses, but a... a... a... celestial force to be reckoned with! Now, where do I sign up for this... this... horse-protectoring job? Oh, and don't expect me to change my name to 'Bimawen' or whatever. I'm still the Great Sage Sun Wukong, and that's final!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Of course, Great Sage Sun Wukong. Your identity and legacy shall remain untarnished by any title, no matter its nature. Your journey as Protector of Horses will be noted, and your ambitions are sure to blaze a trail visible to all in the celestial realm. The formalities will be arranged forthwith, and your duties outlined by the appropriate heavenly offices. You're embarking on a new chapter, one undoubtedly marked with your unique flair and unparalleled zeal.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Unique flair? Unparalleled zeal? I like the sound of that! You people in the heavenly court may not always make sense, but when you talk like that, I can almost see the... the... the... future! A future where I'm not just protecting horses, but... but... leading them! Leading all of you! Well, not you specifically, but... you know what I mean! I'll be the greatest Protector of Horses the universe has ever seen, and then some! Now, where do I go to get my... my... horse-protecting instructions? I have work to do!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Your enthusiasm is truly invigorating, Great Sage. The path forward lies with the Celestial Administration Office. Your vibrant energy and vision for the future are bound to inspire all who encounter you on this journey. May your efforts shine brightly and pave your way to great prominence within the heavenly ranks.

transcript.speaker: antagonist

Safe travels on your path of horse business, and may your journey be rich with success and discovery.
